rule.patches: the unseen patches of the stage-1 unseen face (S1/defs/fig_views_v1.json unseen_face; unseen.npz surf_ext); counted = label_inferred 0 ('맞음으로 미룸', the wall stands there now); label 1 ('틀림으로 미룸', above the current roof) and 2 ('모호') are reported apart (by_label) and left out of 'share'
rule.mesh: 'virtual' = the virtual-view mesh (option 2, order 6.1) where the result has one (the training-view TSDF mesh cannot hold a surface no training view sees); 'tsdf' = the training-view mesh for a result without a renderer (MVS-based fusion, the judgment-swapped variant, samepath); 'surface' = the registered prior surface itself (stage 1 scene 3)
rule.distance: Open3D distance from the patch centre to the mesh crop within 1.5 m of the wall plane (exact for distances <= 0.25 m given TSDF triangles of ~0.05-0.1 m)
rule.stage1_value: VIS-v3 measures/wall.json (B173 주변 only): any-origin Gaussians with opacity >= 0.5 within 0.25 m of the centre, over the 15,366 '맞음으로 미룸' unseen patches of all faces; 'gaussian_supported' = the same count recomputed here on that set and on this wall's counted set
